ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the time during a day, marked from 0 to 24 o'clock; there are three curves in the figure, respectively labeled ①②③. Curve ③ shows an obvious daytime single-peak pattern, rising after about 6 o'clock, reaching a high value around 12—14 o'clock, and approaching zero after 18 o'clock. Curve ① is relatively smooth, still has values at night, and its highest value appears in the afternoon. Curve ② is a dashed line, is not zero at night, rises during the day as ③ strengthens, has its peak around noon, and its changing characteristics are between ③ and ①. Then reason: Solar radiation is obvious only during the day, so ③ corresponds to solar radiation; the daily variation of air temperature is relatively smooth and its highest value usually lags behind solar radiation, so ① corresponds to air temperature change; the remaining ② is the ground radiation curve.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读图可见横轴为0—24时，三条曲线分别标注①②③；③呈白天单峰型，约6时后升高、12—14时前后达峰、18时后接近零；①为较平滑的实线，最高值出现在午后且夜间仍较高；②为虚线，夜间不为零，白天随③升高而增强，峰值在正午前后，位于③和①的变化特征之间。读文字可知题目要求在“太阳辐射、地面辐射和气温变化”三者中找出地面辐射曲线。运用规律：太阳辐射只在白天明显，故③是太阳辐射；气温日变化相对平滑且最高值滞后于太阳辐射，故①是气温；剩下的②就是地面辐射。答案为2。
